fn solve(H: Int, W: Int, h: Int, w: Int) -> Int
  requires (1 <= H)
  requires (H <= 20)
  requires (1 <= W)
  requires (W <= 20)
  requires (1 <= h)
  requires (h <= H)
  requires (1 <= w)
  requires (w <= W)
  ensures (result == ((H - h) * (W - w)))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0, 0, 0) == 0)
